title: Adjective slot: accessible
instructions: Choose the word-family form that makes the complete sentence grammatical and meaningful.

parts.prompt: The revised route is more ___ for wheelchair users because the steep steps have been replaced by a ramp.

choice_rationales.A: Access is usually a noun or verb and does not fit after ‘is more’ in this comparison.
choice_rationales.B: Accessible is the adjective that describes the revised route and matches the ramp evidence.
choice_rationales.C: Accessibly is an adverb, but the linking verb is connects the route to a description.
choice_rationales.D: Accessibility is a noun and would require a different frame, such as ‘has greater accessibility’.

parts.hint: A linking verb connects the route to a describing word, and ‘more’ marks a comparison.
parts.correct_explanation: The comparative frame requires an adjective: the revised route ‘is more accessible’.
